WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name,
    customers.tier
), _cm_orders__net_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(CAST(orders.amount - customers.discount AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.region_net_total"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__net_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier",
    CAST(SUM(CAST(orders.amount - customers.discount AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.net_total"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name,
    customers.tier
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
  _base."orders.customers.tier",
  _cm_orders__net_sum."orders.net_total",
  _cm_orders__net_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name."orders.region_net_total"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__net_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__net_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name."orders.customers.regions.name"
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__net_sum
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__net_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
  AND _base."orders.customers.tier" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__net_sum."orders.customers.tier"
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name" ASC,
  _base."orders.customers.tier" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message:
For each order I took the order amount minus the ordering customer's discount, then added these up by region and customer tier. The last column repeats the total for the whole region on each of its rows.

- **Orders without a customer:** left out. This covers orders with no customer ID and orders whose customer ID doesn't match any customer.
- **Customers without a known region:** they form the group labelled null. It only contains silver-tier customers, with a net total of 627.83.
- **Discount:** I subtracted the discount as a flat amount per order (the values run from 0 to 10). Nothing in the data says whether it's an amount or a percentage, so if it's meant as a percentage these totals would be wrong.

Every customer has a discount and a tier recorded, so no orders were lost to missing values.
